candidate.title: CEL-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina poster CEL-Seq row: three separately indexed single-cell RNA branches converge into a pooled library and cell-resolved sequence output. The left cell-to-poly(A) RNA mini-icons summarize the same analyte, rather than an additional workflow. Neighboring FRISCR, snRNA-seq, STRT and chemical-legend fragments are outside this target; the collection page heading and matching CEL-Seq schematic confirm the scope. Its Similar methods list does not add targets. The extracted route preserves the drawing, with the mislabeled second-strand caption and omitted post-pooling IVT boundary explicitly resolved using the original abstract and a full-text CEL-seq implementation. This is the original CEL-Seq schematic architecture, not CEL-Seq2 or a droplet adaptation.
